name: Super Little Acorns 3D Turbo
description:
Distribution of this software ended at 10:00 on Wednesday, February 24, 2021.

----------------------------------------------
"Super Little Squirrel 3D" is an action puzzle game featuring a cute squirrel character.

While controlling the main character's movements such as running, jumping, and ropes to collect acorns for his family, he clears 90 stages with vivid graphics. Dodge the bees, spiders, bats, and other enemies that get in the way of the squirrel, and get items and cool clothes to power up your character. There are also events where you can challenge a "giant boss" and win a "trophy." It is also characterized by its simple operability, which attracts both adults and children.

Enjoy the cute and exciting adventure of a squirrel.
